* '''Effect:''' You must be [[Dedication|dedicated]] to {{{1}}} to use this item. Once per day, while you are in an area [[consecration|consecrated]] to {{{1}}}, you may spend ten minutes of appropriate roleplaying that includes playing this musical instrument. Any listener who was in the area for the entire period recovers all [[Heroic skills#Hero|hero points]].  You cannot use this ability if you are on a battlefield or in a similar stressful environment. A listener who has lost the ability to recover hero points overnight is not affected by this power.
